item.title: Masthead redesign for established national magazine (draft for critique)
item.description: Was up all night creating this so I can’t see straight right now. To cut on time I went straight into the computer to start building the letters without having skated out what I was going to do first and now I am second guessing myself. Maybe it’s just the lack of sleep that is keeping me from liking this but I can’t figure out at this moment what it is that bothers me about it.
